description.zh-CN: 在每条 AI 回复的页脚显示本次实际使用的模型（provider:model），并为不同模型分配不同的马卡龙色——同一模型始终同色，一段对话中中途切换模型一眼可见。纯前端扩展，不修改任何核心代码。
description.en-US: Shows the model (provider:model) actually used for each AI reply as a footer badge, with a distinct macaron color per model — the same model always keeps the same color, so a model switch mid-chat is immediately visible. Pure frontend extension, no core code changes.
